description: This file defines types, constants, and functions for handling WebRTC messages and configurations within a WebRTC client package. It includes message types, message structures for signaling, factory functions for creating messages, a JSON reshape utility, and configuration related to ICE servers.

methods.name: NewRequestOfferMsg
methods.description: Creates a new RequestOfferMsg with specified ICE servers.

methods.name: NewICECandidateMsg
methods.description: Creates a new ICECandidateMsg with the provided ICECandidateInit.

methods.name: Reshape
methods.description: Converts a generic JSON object into a specific type using marshaling and unmarshaling.
